9373028.name: Left-side Shoulder Touch Pushups (SLTP)

9373029.name: Pistol Pushdowns - DB Waiter Curls (SLTP)

9373031.name: DB Bulgarian Iso Hold at 1-3-0
9373031.description:

Track the weight you lift each week (and use the same weight for each leg).

9373034.name: Leg Curls - Incline DB Shrugs
9373034.description:

9373037.name: 1.5 KB/DB Goblet Squat
9373037.description:

Track the weight you used and the reps you did on that 1 set each week.

9373039.name: Sprinter Situps - V-Ups - Reverse Crunches - Hollow Body Rocks
9373039.description: Whatever you do, do NOT stop in the middle of your set. Complete all 4 exercises in a row.

9373045.description:

Then on this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Arnold Press each week.

9375225.name: Right-side Shoulder Touch Pushups (SLTP)
9375225.description: Track how many reps you get each week.

9375277.name: Lower Body Mobility Routine
9375277.description:
This is the exact mobility flow I do myself before every lower body day. Your goal should be to learn this by heart, and most importantly - DO IT OFTEN

When you start lifting weight, it's easy to get stiff and sore - especially if you're sedentary throughout the day. This is why it's important you keep your circulation up. The more you 'move', the more supple you stay. Never stop moving.

3 seconds to go down, no hold at the bottom, and fast up.

9375658.name: Bent Over Row - Banded Y-T-W's (SLTP)
9375658.description:
You'll start this workout with another 'superset'.

If you don't know what this means, go back to your Phase 1 Day 1 workout and you'll see it there.

From now on, if you see multiple exercises in the title (and video), then that means you will be doing those exercises in a superset.

When it comes to these supersets, I only want you to track the weight you lift on 1 exercise.

In this case, the Bent Over Row.

This renders that exercise you track to be the 'main one', where the goal is to either lift heavier on that 'main one' every week (or do more reps, whatever the requirement is for that week).

9375662.name: DB Bench Press (SLTP)
9375662.description:
Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. 

No need to track your warmup sets, some weeks you might need 2 sets, other weeks you might need more.

Your main goal here is to track your prescribed 'Rep-Max'.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

If your prescribed Rep-Max was a 7 Rep-Max, then how much weight can you lift for 7 reps?

9375663.name: Alternating DB Side Raises - Bent Elbow Shrugs - Pulley High Face Pull (SLTP)
9375663.description:
On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Alternating DB Side Raises for each set.

Then on the Shrugs and Face Pulls after, just go by 'feel' and get a nice pump. 

The Alternating DB Side Raises is the 'main one' on this superset.

9375664.name: Bar Bicep Curl - Incline Skullcrushers - Banded Kickbacks (SLTP)
9375664.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the Bar Bicep Curl for each set.

9375701.name: RKC Plank - Side Plank - Hip Thrust (SLTP)
9375701.description:
You'll start this workout with what is called a 'superset'.

This means you will do 1 set of an exercise, followed by 1 set of a different exercise.

In this case, you'll be doing 3 exercises 'in a row' as shown in the video: 

RKC Plank to a Side Plank to a Hip Thrust.

For the RKC Plank, do 5 'squeezes' per set.

For the Side Plank, hold it for 30 sec per set (each side)

For the Hip Thrust, do 25 reps per set.

Then do that sequence for 3 sets.

This will be your very first 'superset' of the program. 

We will be using this method often (it allows you to do more 'work' in less time).

These exercises do not need to be tracked, as they are mostly bodyweight. And they primarily serve to 'activate' all the right muscles for your big squat coming up next.

(also, if you don't have Sling Shot - just do it without it for now. You can find them on Amazon for $30).

9375703.name: Low Bar Squat (SLTP)
9375703.description:
Start every week with 1 warmup set of 25 reps, either bodyweight or empty / light bar

Then in Week 1, take 3 sets to work up to a 7-Rep Max

This means you hit the MAX weight that you can do properly for 7 reps. 

So for instance, after your warmup, you might start with:

1 set of 7 at 135 lbs - and it goes easy

So you add 25's each side, and now you do 1 set of 7 at 185 lbs - and it's more challenging, but you can still do more...

Then add more weight, until you 'find' the max weight you can only lift for 7 reps...

This is called your '7-rep max'.

Heads-up:

You might need more than 3 sets to 'find' your 7 rep max, feel it out and listen to your body.

Always use safety spotters (usually squat racks have them built in)

Take long breaks in between these sets, this is your strength movement of the day.

Usually if you squat 7 reps and feel like you 'only had 1-2 more reps in you before you fail', then that's where you stop.

Then in week 2, you'll work up to a 6-Rep Max (going heavier, because less reps).

And in week 3, work up to a 5-Rep Max (again going heavier, this is how you'll get stronger on this lift).

9375705.name: DB Lungewalks with 1 Heavy DB on 1 side (SLTP)
9375705.description:
In week 1, you'll do 3 sets of 10 steps each leg (both sides).

The reps will be going down in the following weeks. So next week you'll be going heavier.

That's why in this week, focus on your mind-muscle connection. Feel every step in your glutes (butt) and quads (front side of your legs).

Track the weight you lift. 

And if you weren't able to hit 3 sets of 10 reps on the same weight this week, then track the sets and reps that you did do (along with the weight used).

9375709.name: BB Hip Thrust (SLTP)
9375709.description:
If you don't have a Hip Thrust pad yet, look for a 'squat sponge' on Amazon.

Or if you want something fancy - look for the 'Hip Thrust Pad' from Rogue Fitness (which can also serve as pad for other uses).

9375734.name: DB Bulgarians at 6-0-1 (SLTP)
9375734.description:
This will be your 'big lift' of the workout, and the 6-0-1 stands for:

6 seconds down
0 second hold (so go right back up)
1 second to come back up

Make sure you don't rest between reps, keep changing direction and don't 'catch your breath' at the top.

9375735.name: Weighted GHD Back Extension (SLTP)
9375735.description:
If you do not have access to a Glute Ham Developer (GHD), then look for either the 'leg curl' machine in the gym you're at.

Or try finding a '45 degree' back extension at yuor gym.

If you have neither of those, then perform slider leg curls as shown in the second exercise of this little clip: https://straightupfitness.wistia.com/medias/76qp9yzh66

9375739.name: Bodyweight Cossack Squats (SLTP)
9375739.description:
No need to really track the weight on this this one, as your volume will go up every week.

So I recommend actually doing it with bodyweight only.

And if you have a hard time going all the way down, you can hold on to something in front of you.

(it does help to stretch your calves good before this, as you probably already do anyway =))

9375741.name: Anti-Rotation Alphabet Spells (SLTP)
9375741.description:

If done on bands, track the band color.

If on cables, track the weight attached.

9375746.name: DB Farmers Walks (SLTP)
9375746.description:
First track the weight you have in your hands.

Then in your 'reps' simple track the distance you covered in your prescribed amount of seconds.

9375760.name: 1-Arm Lat Pulldown - Incline DB Rear Raises - Band Pullaparts (SLTP)
9375760.description: On this superset, only track the REPS x WEIGHT you lift on the 1-Arm Lat Pulldown for each set.

9375766.name: Bar Bicep Curl - Pulley Tricep Pushdown (SLTP)
9375766.description:
Perform the prescribed reps in as little sets as possible.

Then track the weight lifted, and the time it took for you to complete all reps on BOTH exercises.

Then use the same weight each week, but try to take less breaks as you progress.

You can either do all biceps first, and then triceps. Or vice versa. Or switch it up, totally up to you.

9375774.name: Incline DB Bench Press at 6-0-1 (SLTP)
9375774.description:
Going down in 6 seconds (which is a LONG time with heavy weights)

Holding it for zero seconds at the bottom

Then launching it up in 1 second.

Count with Mis-sis-sip-pi seconds here!

9375776.name: 1-Arm DB Floor Press (SLTP)
9375776.description:
Make sure ONLY your tricep hits the ground, not your actual elbow.

This keeps the tension on the muscle, and helps your shoulders stay engaged.

9375781.name: L-Lateral Raise to Long Lever Eccentric (SLTP)
9375781.description:
The hardest part is when you stick your hands out and make yourself wide.

Brace your stomach and squeeze your butt before you get there.

We'll be using the same weight in all 3 weeks on this one (increasing the volume each week).

9375823.description:

Both facepulls and pullthroughs can be on bands or cables.

And if you do not have a GHD - resort to a Slider Leg Curl instead (or look up the 'leg curl machine' in your gym).

Perform 1-2 warmup sets with 10 reps at a light weight.

See how you feel, and gradually increase the weight. 

No need to track your warmup sets, some weeks you might need 2 sets, other weeks you might need more.

Your main goal here is to track your prescribed 'Rep-Max'.

So what is the max weight you lifted for the reps prescribed?

If your prescribed Rep-Max was a 7 Rep-Max, then how much weight can you lift for 7 reps?

And if you're prescribed a 7 Rep-Max, but you tried 225 lbs and only hit 5 reps, then record those reps x weights instead.

The app will then keep track of your strength progression on this lift.

10402734.description:

10402737.description:

10402738.name: GHD Leg Curls - Offset Pushups - Lateral Hurdle Jumps (SLTP)
10402738.description: No need to track anything on this superset

13125864.name: Side Planks - Single Leg DB Deadlifts
13125864.description:
This superset will be the general warmup for the leg day coming up. Grab light Dumbbells (no need to log the weight) and perform the prescribed amount of reps on both the side planks & single leg deadlifts without stopping in between.

So, right side side planks... followed by left side side planks... followed by right side DB Deadlifts... followed by left side DB deadlifts

... followed by the prescribed amount of rest

Then repeat for however many sets is prescribed.

13125866.name: Jump Squats
13125866.description:
Every week you'll perform more sets x reps. Keep this exercise at bodyweight, and focus on jumping higher and moe explosive every rep.

This will properly fire you up for the deadlifts coming up next.

13125868.name: DB Deadlifts
13125868.description:
Every week you will attempt to go heavier on your '6 Rep Max'.

Your 6 Rep Max means the most amount of weight you can lift for 6 reps.

In order to 'find' this weight, you will need to ramp up towards it. Start by doing 6 reps at a light weight.

Then 6 reps a little heavier.

Keep going heavier and heavier until you feel like you have found THAT weight that you can ONLY do 6 reps on with good form.

Then log that weight, the goal here is to increase this weight every week.

13125871.name: Landmine Single Leg Squat
13125871.description: Every week you'll perform more sets and reps. The goal is to use the same weight every week.

13125877.name: DB Hammer Curls - Short Jump Squats
13125877.description:
Perform the prescribed reps as fast as possible, then log how long it took you to complete both exercises.

The goal here is to use the same weight every week, but complete 5 MORE reps on both exercises in the same time.

13125880.name: Banded Rear Flyes - Banded Tricep Pushdowns
13125880.description:
Perform these 2 warmup exercises in a row without stopping in between

After completing them both, rest for the prescribed amount of seconds - then repeat for however many sets is prescribed

Since this is the warmup, keep it light and 'feel' the muscle activate. No need to track weights here, simply get your heart rate up and muscles warm

13125882.name: Plyo Pushups off Bench
13125882.description:
Go all out with this exercise - meaning, really EXPLODE up off the bench.

The key here is to 'activate' your upper body muscle and prime yourself for the big lift coming next (the DB Incline Bench Press)

13125883.name: DB Incline Bench Press
13125883.description:
This is one of the greatest exercises you can do for building nice shoulders, arms, and fixing your posture.

The goal here is to hit your '8 Rep Max'

That means, the heaviest weight you can lift for 8 reps

That weight, where if you do it, you couldn't get any more than 8 reps

Those first 3,4 reps are ok

Rep 5,6 are tough

And with rep 7 and 8 you're testing your own grit and tapping into the depths of your soul to complete them

That is your 8 rep max

Take some warmup sets to 'find' this weight for you. The goal here is to increase your 8 Rep Max over the 3 weeks of Phase 1.

13125885.name: Incline DB Row - Landmine Shoulder Press
13125885.description:
Perform the Landmine Shoulder Press right after the DB Row

Every week you will be either adding sets or reps, so the goal here is to stick to the same weight every week (and still complete it without stopping, even though you're increasing reps every week)

13125886.name: DB Incline Skullcrushers
13125886.description:
These Skullcrushers are your 'Finisher' for Phase 1 Day 2 - the goal is to choose a 'nice' weight that you like

Then complete the prescribed amount of reps as fast as possible, with the least amount of stops

So, don't just choose a superlight weight. Because then you'll just breeze through in 1 set.

Choose a weight that forces you to stop at least once before hitting the prescribed amount of reps.

Then time how long it took to complete. And the following week you'll be asked to perform more reps - the goal is to then complete those extra reps in the same time (so you can get nice and toned and finally get definition in the first part any man looks at on a woman - the backside of her arms)

13125888.name: Pallof Press - Single Leg Ring Squat
13125888.description:
Perform the Pallof press and Single Leg Squats in a row without stopping in between


So both sides on the press... followed immediately by single leg squats on both legs... and then you rest for the prescribed seconds of rest

Keep it light and 'feel' the muscle activate. 

No need to track weights here, simply get your heart rate up and muscles warm

13125889.name: Kettlebell Swings
13125889.description:
This is not only your opportunity to WAKE up your butt (so that it's active for the hip thrusts coming up)

But this is also your chance to learn the most abused exercise ever, and do a proper Kettlebell swing

Practice the Hinge-Hike-Root-Float concept, and whatever you do - DON'T overthink it

Let your body move naturally, and squeeze your butt as hard as you can to thrust the KB to the front

Pretend your on the dancefloor, and the kettlebell is your partner. Feel it in your butt!

13125892.name: Hip Thrusts
13125892.description:
This will be one of your 2 'Big Lifts' for today

The goal here will be to find your 10 Rep Max

So, as you should know by now, the heaviest weight you can lift for 1 set of 10 reps

Take some time and warmup sets to 'find' this weight, and remember - the butt is a high maintenance muscle, it needs a lot of attention to stick around. Punish it hard.

13125894.name: Narrow Pullup
13125894.description:
This is your other 'Big Lift' of the day

It doesn't matter which method you choose in doing these, however make sure to stick to the same method every week.

The goal here is to complete the prescribed reps faster every week. 

Pullups keep you honest! If you can't do them yet, it's probably because you weigh too much. So inadvertently this will make you think twice about eating those cookies diabetic Debbie brought into the lunchroom. 

Spray windex on those cookies and do pullups instead, diabetes is not something I would recommend anyway.

13125898.name: Landmine Windshield Wipers - 1 DB Overhead Crunches
13125898.description:
Your finisher for Phase 1 Day 3 is all abs

Now before you do them, you should know that abs are made in the kitchen

Cliché, I know. But I have a 6-pack. And I never do these exercises.

The only reason I put them in this routine is to get you a little sore in your stomach, so next time you're about to dive head-first into some nachos, your ab muscles will remind you to have some Icelandic yoghurt instead (with cinnamon)

The only way you'll get a flat stomach is eating right. Exercise is for stress relief anyway.

But with that said, this is a great finisher - do the prescribed amount of reps on BOTH in the shortest amount of time.

You can do all on 1 exercise first and then go to the other. Or you can alternate, as long as you hit the prescribed amount of reps on both exercises as fast as possible (and time it)

13125956.name: Slider Planks - Bodyweight Cossack Squats - Face Pulls
13125956.description:
This warmup set has it all, pure unadulterated drama - combined with face pulls to fix your posture

Go light, but get yourself huffing and puffing a little at the same time. You're doing squats up next, better warmup properly!

13125959.name: Box Jump
13125959.description:
There is no better way of 'activating' your body for a heavy leg day than box jumps.

Not only do they force you to RAISE your knees up, they also have you take a mental risk of jumping on top of something.

If you struggle with this, start low. And if you find that you just can't get yourself to jump - you should know that it's 100% mental. If you keep trying, you will eventually do it.

And when you do, that feeling will be so, so sweet.

Keep practicing. And if you already conquered one height, go higher.

13125961.name: Barbell Squat
13125961.description:
Some say this is the 'king' of all exercises - and I could agree...

I wouldn't personally say it's the end-all exercise, but it's definitely one of the top 5

It requires you to not only use all your muscles at the same time, it really taxes your mental fortitude as well

It's somewhat synonymous to life - the weight (life) pushes you down, down, down... and it will KEEP you there if you let it

But then you push that weight back up, and every week you get stronger and stronger.

Until that weight that used to be scary is your warmup now.

Goal here is a 6 Rep Max, go get it!

13125962.name: DB Step-Up
13125962.description:
Very important to NOT use your bottom foot to lift yourself off here. Let most of your 'force' come from the foot that's on the bench.

Goal here is to stick to the same weight every week (and do more sets x reps as the weeks go on)

13125967.name: Barbell Standing Curls - Bodyweight Bulgarians
13125967.description:
Since the Bulgarians in this Finisher are bodyweight (don't underestimate them), you will only need to track the weight on the Barbell curls.

Goal here is to complete the prescribed reps as fast as possible. But of course, don't swing the weights up. Keep it lady-like and brace your stomach hard.

13125968.name: Single Arm Row - Strippers - Skiers
13125968.description:
You do use weight on the Incline Skiers, but no need to track it.

This is merely a warmup to get you ready for the Seated DB Shoulder Press coming up.

Keep it light, and prioritize the Stripper Pushups on this one. Such a great exercise for tricep strength and shoulder mobility.

13125970.name: Forward Ball Throws - Ball Slams
13125970.description:
If you have a brick wall, use it for the ball throws.

If not, then try lining up 3 balls in a row so you don't have to walk back and forth.

Or, just throw and run to get it again.

Make sure you SLAM that ball on the downward ball slams though. Such an amazing exercise to fire up the lats (your back muscle underneath your armpits)

13125972.name: Seated DB Shoulder Presses
13125972.description:
Whenever you sit down on a weightlifting exercise, things can get precarious.

It's easy to kinda 'let go' of your stomach and simply relax your core muscles since you're sitting down.

Do NOT do this.

Keep your stomach even harder, and flex your biceps hard. You should be a total statue when lifting these dumbbells up. And if you feel like your shoulders are achey, don't go down too low.

And remember - fast up, slow down. Accelerate that weight up.

Goal here is an 8 Rep Max.

13125973.name: Barbell Bent Over Row
13125973.description:
You can see the exact instructions in the video, but one thing I forgot to mention - push your stomach out a little bit.

This applies to any time you stick your butt out - if you extend your stomach to the front a little, it helps maintain a natural curve in your lower back.

So inhale, put that air in your stomach. Then lock it in by pushing your belly button out a little bit.

Then stick your butt out backwards, grab that bar and boom boom. Row it to the top row of your 6-pack.

Same weight every week (the sets x reps will go up)

13125974.name: DB Standing Front-To-Side Raises - BB Dive-Under Extensions
13125974.description:
The Front-to-side raises serve here to 'pre-fatigue' your arms before you do the main exercise of this finisher - which is the Dive-Under extensions.

I love the Dive-Unders as it allows you to really stretch your triceps in that bottom position. 

Then pressing from that position just makes you KNOW you're tearing that muscle apart.

Focus on how fast you can complete the prescribed reps on the Dive-Unders here. Every week you'll be doing more volume (reps).

13125975.name: Standing Banded Crunches - Banded Squat - Banded Pullthroughs
13125975.description:
Really 'think' about your butt on these Banded Pullthroughs here.

Doing banded exercises is always a great way to activate muscle (especially considering the band gets tighter the further you pull it)

13125977.name: Forward Broad Jumps
13125977.description:
The thing with broad jumps (and any explosive lift in general really), is that the first 1-2 sets always kinda suck.

It's that 2nd and 3rd set where your muscles are awake and you start getting smooth.

So if you feel like an old person on your first set, just know that your second set will have you feeling 10 years younger.

Unfortunately, most people never make it to that second set.

Sofia Vergara does though. She always makes it to the third set.

13125979.name: Hip Thrusts (heavier than last week)
13125979.description:
The exact same exercise AND reps as last week

The only difference is that I want you to lift heavier now. This is go time. It's either this or surgery, and this is way cheaper.

13125980.name: Neutral Grip Pullup
13125980.description:
Just like with the Hip Thrust, in Day 3 you'll be doing the exact same Pullups AND reps as last week

The only difference is the grip.

This time I want you to with your hands a little wider (palms facing each other if possible, this hits different angles in your back).

And try to break last week's record too! (perform them faster)

13125984.name: DB Thrusters - Hanging Leg Raises
13125984.description:
You can do either 5 Thrusters, then 5 Leg Raises, and 3 Thrusters followed by 3 Leg Raises...

... or you can do all 15 Thrusters in a row, followed by 15 Leg Raises in a row

Whichever you prefer

Just get all the prescribed reps in, and log the time it took you to complete the reps on both exercises (the goal is to complete more reps every week in the same time)

13126050.name: Lateral Hurdle Jumps
13126050.description: Get violent and explosive on these - and increase the length or height you jump every week.

13126051.name: Barbell Deadlift
13126051.description:
The one exercise that uses THE most amount of muscle per rep.... the Barbell Deadlift

Quick tips here:

- Pull your hands towards your legs / shins
- Push your bellybutton out and keep your chest up
- Once the bar is off the floor, accelerate that bar as FAST as possible, squeezing your butt hard at the top

Goal here is a 6 Rep Max, go heavy!

13126052.name: Goblet Squat
13126052.description:
Can be done with either a Kettlebell or Dumbbell, but since the sets x reps are pretty low, make sure you do go heavy

(and go all the way down, actively push those knees out, and keep pressure on your heels when coming up)

Also, stick to the same weight throughout this entire phase

13126055.name: Dumbbell Bicep 21's - Bodyweight Hip Thrust w/ Slingshot
13126055.description:
You'll start this finisher with a full round of Dumbbell 21's... after which you do the prescribed amount of Hip Thrusts as fast as possible

So to reiterate:

7 bicep curls halfway up
7 bicep curls from the top halfway down
7 bicep curls all the way

... and then get into the Hip Thrust and go boom boom fast. Time how long it took you to complete the prescribed amount of reps.

13126062.name: Flat DB Bench Press
13126062.description:
We're going for an 8 Rep Max here

Take your time in ramping up, and as always with every upper body move - make sure to SQUEEZE your shoulder blades as hard as possible

13127511.name: Ring Pushaways - Banded Leg Curls - Ring Face Pull - Back Extensions
13127511.description:
The beauty here is that this entire warmup round is bodyweight. 

So no need to track weights, simply 'feel' your lower body and core activate every round.

This is 4 exercises in a row, for most people this would entail their entire workout.

But you're doing it now as your warmup, this is hard work! Let's go...

13127512.name: Overhand DB Row - Overhead Extensions - Squeezepresses - Bicycle Crunches
13127512.description:
Log the weights you lift on the rows and presses here, and try to have them be the same weight 

This is another lengthy warmup, and you'll be adding sets x reps later on, so keep it light and classy

('classy' here being: good form, 'feeling' the muscle)

13127514.name: Landmine Throw & Catch - Fast Pulldowns - Ball Vertical Throws
13127514.description:
Log the weight of the ball you throw, and especially with the landmine throw - just go light

The main idea here is to 'excite' your upper body muscles and get them ready for the DB Bench Press coming up

13127516.name: Dumbbell Pullover
13127516.description:
The big mistake people make here is bringing that Dumbbell all the way towards their chest / stomach area

Keep it behind you, and really 'reach' for the floor almost. Feel that stretch in your lats, then 'pull' against that stretch to tear that muscle apart. But keep the tension on there.

Stick with the same weight in the phase, you're addin sets x reps later.

13127518.name: Standing Arnold Presses - Diamond Pushups
13127518.description:
Log the weight you use on the Arnold's, but put your main focus on how fast you can complete those diamond pushups.

Diamond pushups are all triceps... and core

Which makes them a full-body movement if you do them on your toes.

They're one those exercises that are so much harder than they look. Don't underestimate them, and keep that stomach tight!

13127520.name: 2 Dumbbell Overhead Crunches - Barbell Glute Bridges - Slingshot Sideway Walks - DB Rear Raises
13127520.description:
Another big warmup round for you, hitting your entire body as you go through these motions

Of course, keep it light - and if you're only going to log one weight here, let it be the glue bridge as that's the biggest lift in this superset.

13127524.name: Weighted Jump Squat with hold
13127524.description:
Hold your squat in the bottom range for 5 seconds each rep

So that's jump... land... stay low for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5... jump again... land... stay low for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 for however many reps is prescribed

13127526.name: Barbell Hip Thrusts (5 Rep Max super heavy)
13127526.description:
This is your phase 3 of your Driven Woman Transformation Program, and it is HERE that I want you to go as heavy as possible with your hip thrusts

We're doing a 5 Rep Max, which is half of the reps you started with in Phase 1... that means you'll have so much more power to give each rep

Go all out, get aggressive and attack that bar!

13127527.name: Wide Pullups
13127527.description:
The same principles as the last 2 Phases - except this time you're going with a wide grip.

The wide grip is by far the hardest pullup, and pay attention to what I mention in the video - using your biceps to 'break' the bar as you come up.

Time how long it took you to complete all 20 (and perform them in the same manner you did the previous phases - so either hanging, banded, or with feet on the ground)

13127529.name: Dumbbell Deadlift Lunge walks - Decline Crunches
13127529.description:
In your final finisher of Phase 3, you'll be doing a certain amount of reps on the lungewalks and crunches in the shortest amount of time.

So just like previously, you can either do 5 lungewalks, 5 crunches... and then another 3 lungewalks with 3 crunches...

Or you can just finish all your lungewalks and then continue with the crunches

Log how long it took you to complete all reps on both exercises.

13127532.name: Ball Woodchoppers - DB Rear Lunge - Landmine Squats
13127532.description:
Perform these 3 warmup exercises in a row without stopping in between.

You only rest after the landmine squats. After which you do the ball woodchoppers again to start another set.

Since this is a warmup, there's no need to track weights - but if you feel like it, track what you lifted on the landmine squats (and make sure to push your knees OUT on those squats, feeling that stretch in your inner thighs as you go down).

13127534.name: DB Bugarians - BB Glute Bridges
13127534.description:
Since this is Deload, we're going straight into an accessory 'superset' 

(you should know what that means by now, but if you don't - message me)

On this superset, both exercises will build your butt.

But only if you push it hard like Salt n Pepa did in the 90's

The Glute Bridge allows you to go heavy too, since it's so low to the floor. Only track the weight you lift on the glute bridge here.

13127537.name: Landmine Floor Raises w/ Calf Extensions
13127537.description:
Put your all into this one - prepare yourself mentally and make sure to keep breathing throughout your 30 reps.

Add in a bonus calf extension at the top for extra credit. Extra credit which you can exchange later for nicer looking calves, and better ankle flexibility.

This might just be the most stress-relieving exercise out there.

13127539.name: Jump Rope Sprints
13127539.description:
The goal here is to finish the prescribed amount of 'jumps' in the shortest amount of time. 

Every Deload week we'll be adding 250 jumps to the set, so the goal really is to keep your time the same (getting faster)

Quick tip: If you don't have a jumprope yet, or you have one that sucks - I really like the Thai  Jumprope from Rogue Fitness (they're a little heavier, but train your forearms and have a good rhythm)

13127540.name: Band Pullaparts - Wide Pushups - 2-Bench Dips
13127540.description:
This entire warmup sequence is all bands and bodyweight, so focus on 'feeling' the muscle on every rep.

Keep your chest to the front on the bands (and pull that band ALL the way back)

Keep your back straight on the pushups (and squeeze your shoulder blades on the way down)

And stick your butt out backwards on those bench dips (and aim your nose towards the floor, keeping your hands in front of your hips)

13127541.name: 1 Arm DB Shoulder Press - 1 Arm DB Row - Pullup Iso Hold
13127541.description:
On this superset, log both the weights you lifted for the presses and rows... AND how many seconds you were able to hold that pullup position

Holding a pullup halfway is an awesome technique to increase your pullup strength

(if you currently weigh too much to hold a pullup, find a lower bar and perform this with your feet on the ground and use your arms to hold yourself up as much as possible)

13127543.name: DB Renegade Rows
13127543.description:
The hardest part in this exercise is NOT letting your butt drop when going down.

Even though it's a pushup with extra arm movement, the main emphasis here is your core strength.

Keep that stomach tight, and don't forget to flex your legs hard (and squeeze your butt).

13127546.name: Overhead Banded Extensions
13127546.description:
Track the band you're using (which resistance, or color) - and the time it took you to complete the prescribed reps.

Also, go ALL the way back with your hands. Really feel that stretch from your elbows to your shoulders, stretching that tricep muscle out.

13127552.name: 1 Arm Farmers Walks
13127552.description:
The goal here is to cover the most amount of distance in 90 seconds.

So log not only the weight you lift, but also how many feet you actually walked in those 90 seconds.

Obviously, do one side first. Then rest, and do the other side.

The goal here is to cover more distance every Deload week (keeping the weight of the Dumbbell the same).

13127554.name: Toe Touches - Suicide Planks - Hollow Body Rocks
13127554.description:
A quick ground-based ab routine to REMIND you... that abs are made in the kitchen.

For extra motivation, put your fingers on your stomach when doing these, and feel the fat just BURNING off

(it's not actually burning off, the only way you burn that off is by sticking to the meal plan)

Push through on these, ground based ab exercises do increase core strength, and in particular 'pull' your belly button in more (making your stomach flatter when at rest)

13127833.name: Banded Kickouts - DB Sumo Squats - Y-to-Handcuffs - Sideway Overhead Ball Slams
13127833.description:
No need to log anything on this warmup, but pay close attention to your form on those sideway overhead ball slams.

You should be feeling those big time in your stomach, and raising that ball as high as possible before violently SLAMMING it down to your other side.

This helps big time with rotational strength (aka, it keeps your spine healthy)
